system.effect: Causes victims in a 30' cubic volume to fall upward
system.description: This spell affects all creatures and objects within a cubic volume 30'x 30'x 30', causing them to "fall" in a direction opposite the normal gravity. In two seconds, creatures and objects can "fall" a maximum of 65'. No saving throw is allowed, and all victims hitting a ceiling or other obstruction take 1d6 points of damage per 10' "fallen.
